title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Evidence Package MCP Tool Implementation v0.1
objective: Use TDD and the test pyramid to implement only the additive assemble_repair_evidence_package MCP tool by reusing the package-owned repair evidence-package runner, accepting required handoffPackagePath, dryRunReportPath, validationReportPath, patchPlanPath and optional outputDir, while preserving bounded output, redaction, maintainer review, installed-consumer, no-command, and no-target-write boundaries from ADR-0024.
acceptance: Preserve all eleven existing MCP tools unchanged and add only assemble_repair_evidence_package.
Reuse the package-owned repair evidence-package runner without duplicating domain logic.
Require handoffPackagePath, dryRunReportPath, validationReportPath, and patchPlanPath; support only optional outputDir.
Return only packagePath, markdownPath, taskCount, and status as bounded structured output.
Declare readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint false, and openWorldHint false.
Prove fail-closed errors, text and structured redaction, real tools/list and tools/call, installed consumer compatibility, maintainer review, and no target repository writes.
Treat validationReportPath as existing evidence only; do not execute validation commands.
Keep validation-only execution, arbitrary commands, resources, prompts, automatic patch application, publication, and deployment outside this Goal.
